text:
```yaml
name: Link Checker

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  link-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Cache Cargo
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Run lychee
        uses: lycheeverse/lychee-action@v2
        with:
          args: --verbose --format detailed --fail --exclude "https://github.com" --exclude "https://twitter.com" --exclude "https://discord.gg" .
          fail: true
```
